evidence.quote: While the study uses well-established datasets, these may not fully represent real-world coding challenges. Future work with diverse datasets and newer LLMs could improve generalizability.
The results are robust for the chosen datasets, but expanding the dataset size would improve reliability and generalizability for broader programming scenarios.
Using SHAP to analyze only the top five metrics might miss other important relationships.
Also, relying on LLM-generated test cases could introduce misalignment if they fail to fully capture task requirements, highlighting a need to reduce hallucinations.

Fixed parameters (like temperature and max tokens) were set to balance consistency and creativity in code generation. However, broader experimentation with these settings could optimize results for different tasks.
